facts.business: Saint-Gobain Sekurit India Limited manufactures and sells automotive glass products, including manufactured products and stock-in-trade, and provides tool development and other operating services.

auditor.name: Not stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Revenue recognition cut-off risk leading to potential overstatement of revenue from operations due to booking of revenues pertaining to post year-end
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for material related party transactions with Saint-Gobain India Private Limited for purchase, sale or transfer of products, goods, consumables, materials, assets, services, obligations and other transactions up to an aggregate amount not exceeding Rs 150 Crores until the next AGM. Payables to related parties include Rs 75.77 lakhs (March 31, 2026) and Rs 153.41 lakhs (March 31, 2025). Capital expenditure payable to related parties was Rs 2.61 lakhs (March 31, 2025).
